name: Ducati Lenovo Team
altImageText: Ducati Lenovo Team rider leaning into a corner on the red 2026 Desmosedici GP
description: Based in Bologna, Italy, Ducati Corse runs the Desmosedici GP in 2026. The factory squad has taken premier-class titles with Casey Stoner (2007), Francesco Bagnaia (2022, 2023) and Marc Marquez (2025).

name: Aprilia Racing
altImageText: Aprilia Racing rider in the garage wearing the black 2026 team leathers
description: Based in Noale, Italy, Aprilia Racing fields the RS-GP in 2026. Aprilia has no premier-class riders' title yet, but has become a regular race winner since 2022.

name: BK8 Gresini Racing MotoGP
altImageText: Alex Marquez on the grid on the white and blue BK8 Gresini Ducati
description: Based in Faenza, Italy, Gresini Racing runs the Ducati Desmosedici GP as an independent team in 2026. Founded by Fausto Gresini, it is one of the grid's longest-running satellite squads.

name: Honda HRC Castrol
altImageText: Luca Marini and Joan Mir in red, white and blue Honda HRC Castrol leathers
description: Honda's factory team is based in Japan and races the RC213V in 2026. Honda is the most successful manufacturer in premier-class history, with titles for Spencer, Gardner, Doohan, Rossi, Hayden, Stoner and Marquez.

name: Honda LCR
altImageText: Johann Zarco posing in the green, white and red LCR Honda leathers in the studio
description: Run by Lucio Cecchinello from Monaco, LCR races the Honda RC213V as a satellite team. Rookie Diogo Moreira joins veteran Johann Zarco in 2026.

name: Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP
altImageText: Fabio Quartararo and Alex Rins shaking hands between their blue Monster Energy Yamaha YZR-M1 bikes
description: Yamaha's factory team is based in Iwata, Japan, and races the YZR-M1 in 2026. Yamaha has won premier-class titles with Roberts, Lawson, Rainey, Rossi, Lorenzo and Quartararo.

name: Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team
altImageText: Top view of the two fluorescent yellow and black Pertamina Enduro VR46 Ducati bikes
description: Founded by Valentino Rossi and based in Tavullia, Italy, the team runs the Ducati Desmosedici GP in 2026. It entered MotoGP in 2022.

name: Prima Pramac Yamaha MotoGP
altImageText: Jack Miller and Toprak Razgatlioglu in purple and blue Prima Pramac Yamaha leathers with team management
description: Based in Italy, Pramac switched from Ducati to Yamaha in 2026 and races the YZR-M1. Jorge Martin won the 2024 title with the team on a Ducati.

name: Red Bull KTM Factory Racing
altImageText: Pedro Acosta, Brad Binder, Enea Bastianini and Maverick Vinales on their orange Red Bull KTM RC16 bikes
description: Based in Mattighofen, Austria, KTM races the RC16 in 2026. The factory has won Grands Prix since 2020 but no premier-class title yet.

name: Red Bull KTM Tech3
altImageText: Maverick Vinales smiling next to his Red Bull KTM Tech3 RC16
description: Founded by Herve Poncharal in France, Tech3 runs KTM RC16 bikes as KTM's satellite team. Vinales and Bastianini both carry race-winning experience.

name: SuperFile Trackhouse MotoGP Team
altImageText: Ai Ogura seated in the garage wearing the black and neon yellow SuperFile Trackhouse leathers
description: The American Trackhouse squad took over the former RNF entry in 2024 and races the Aprilia RS-GP. It is an independent team.
